name: Tokimeki Memorial 2
source:
Tokimeki Memorial 2 takes the basic story of the first game where you are playing a male student through his 3 years of high school but this time when you first play you start out as a kid who then later moves away.

(summary from http://kojioe.wordpress.com/2009/02/23/tokimeki-memorial-2-nostalgia-review-part-1/)
translation:
《心跳回忆2》沿用了初代的基本故事框架：玩家扮演一名男学生，度过三年高中生活。不过，本作第一次游玩时会从主人公的童年开始，随后他才搬离故乡。

（简介摘自http://kojioe.wordpress.com/2009/02/23/tokimeki-memorial-2-nostalgia-review-part-1/）
